WITH "RankedTransactions" AS (SELECT
		 "Accrual Transaction ID",
		 "Transaction Date",
		 "Entity Type",
		 "Transaction Number",
		 "Debit or Credit",
		 /* Zoho Analytics allows standard REPLACE functions to strip out currency symbols and thousands separators */ CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Debit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL) AS "Clean_Debit",
		 CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Credit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL) AS "Clean_Credit",
		 
			CASE
				 WHEN "Debit or Credit"  = 'debit' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Debit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL)
				 ELSE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Credit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL)
			 END AS "Match_Amount",
		 /* Window functions are fully supported in Zoho Analytics Query Tables */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY "Transaction Date" , 
			CASE
				 WHEN "Debit or Credit"  = 'debit' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Debit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL)
				 ELSE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Credit Amount", 'INR ', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL)
			 END  ORDER BY "Accrual Transaction ID" ) AS "Pair_Rank"
FROM  "Accrual Transactions (Zoho Books)" 
WHERE	 "Account ID"  = 1094368000009585036)
SELECT
		 Dr."Transaction Date" AS "Matching_Date",
		 Dr."Match_Amount" AS "Amount",
		 Dr."Transaction Number" AS "Debit_Transaction",
		 Dr."Entity Type" AS "Debit_Source",
		 Cr."Transaction Number" AS "Credit_Transaction",
		 Cr."Entity Type" AS "Credit_Source",
		 
			CASE
				 WHEN Cr."Accrual Transaction ID"  IS NOT NULL THEN 'MATCHED'
				 ELSE 'MISMATCH (Orphan Debit)'
			 END AS "Reconciliation_Status"
FROM  "RankedTransactions" Dr
LEFT JOIN "RankedTransactions" Cr ON Dr."Transaction Date"  = Cr."Transaction Date"
	 AND	Dr."Match_Amount"  = Cr."Match_Amount"
	 AND	Dr."Pair_Rank"  = Cr."Pair_Rank"
	 AND	Dr."Debit or Credit"  = 'debit'

WHERE	 Dr."Debit or Credit"  = 'debit'
UNION ALL

		 Cr."Transaction Date" AS "Matching_Date",
		 Cr."Match_Amount" AS "Amount",
		 NULL AS "Debit_Transaction",
		 NULL AS "Debit_Source",
		 Cr."Transaction Number" AS "Credit_Transaction",
		 Cr."Entity Type" AS "Credit_Source",
		 'MISMATCH (Orphan Credit)' AS "Reconciliation_Status"
FROM  "RankedTransactions" Cr
LEFT JOIN "RankedTransactions" Dr ON Cr."Transaction Date"  = Dr."Transaction Date"
	 AND	Cr."Match_Amount"  = Dr."Match_Amount"

		 SUM("Inv_Base"."Net Qty") OVER(PARTITION BY "Inv_Base"."Product ID"  ORDER BY "Inv_Base"."Date"  ROWS  BETWEEN  UNBOUNDED  PRECEDING  AND  CURRENT  ROW ) AS "Cumulative_Stock_Qty",
		 round(SUM("Inv_Base"."Total") OVER(PARTITION BY "Inv_Base"."Product ID"  ORDER BY "Inv_Base"."Date"  ROWS  BETWEEN  UNBOUNDED  PRECEDING  AND  CURRENT  ROW ), 2) AS "Cumulative_Stock_Value",
		 round(SUM("Inv_Base"."Total") OVER(PARTITION BY "Inv_Base"."Product ID" , "Inv_Base"."Date"   ROWS  BETWEEN  UNBOUNDED  PRECEDING  AND  CURRENT  ROW ), 2) AS "N_Cumulative_Stock_Value"
FROM (/* --- Inner Subquery Start --- */
	SELECT
			 'In' as "Type",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Stock In Flow ID" "PK",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Product ID" "Product ID",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Location ID" "Warehouse ID",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Warehouse Location ID" "Location Id",

			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Quantity In" as "Purchased Quantity",
			 0 as "Sold Quantity",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Total (BCY)" as "Total",
			 0 as "Committed Stock",
			 "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Quantity In" as "Net Qty"
	FROM  "Stock In Flow Table (Zoho Books)" 
	UNION ALL
 	SELECT
			 'Out' as "Type",
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Stock Out Flow ID" "PK",
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Product ID",
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Location ID",
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Warehouse Location ID",
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Transaction Date",
			 0,
			 "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Out",
			 -1 * SUM("FIFO Mapping Table (Zoho Books)"."Total (BCY)"),
			 0,
			 -1 * "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Out"
	FROM  "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"
LEFT JOIN "FIFO Mapping Table (Zoho Books)" ON "Stock Out Flow Table (Zoho Books)"."Stock Out Flow ID"  = "FIFO Mapping Table (Zoho Books)"."Stock Out Flow ID"  
	GROUP BY 1,
		 2,
		 3,
		 4,
		 5,
		 6,
		  8 
	UNION ALL
 	SELECT
			 'Transfer' as "Type",
			 "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Item ID" "PK",
			 "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Product ID",
			 "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Location ID",
			 "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Location ID",
			 "Transfer Order (Zoho Books)"."Date",
			 IF("Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity"  > 0, "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity", 0),
			 IF("Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity"  < 0, "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity" * -1, 0),
			 "Inventory Adjustment Items (Zoho Books)"."Price (BCY)" * "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity",
			 0,
			 "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transferred Quantity"
	FROM  "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"
LEFT JOIN "Transfer Order (Zoho Books)" ON "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Transfer Order ID"  = "Transfer Order (Zoho Books)"."Transfer Order ID" 
LEFT JOIN "Inventory Adjustment Items (Zoho Books)" ON "Inventory Adjustment Items (Zoho Books)"."Inventory Adjustment Item ID"  = "Transfer Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Item ID"  
	UNION ALL
 	SELECT
			 'Committed' as "Type",
			 "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Item ID" "PK",
			 "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Product ID",
			 "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Location ID",
			 "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Location ID",
			 "Sales Orders (Zoho Books)"."Order Date",
			 0,
			 0,
			 0,
			 COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity"), 0) -COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Invoiced"), 0) -COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Cancelled"), 0), 0),
			 -1 * COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity"), 0) -COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Invoiced"), 0) -COALESCE(SUM("Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Quantity Cancelled"), 0), 0)
	FROM  "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"
LEFT JOIN "Sales Orders (Zoho Books)" ON "Sales Orders (Zoho Books)"."Sales order ID"  = "Sales Order Items (Zoho Books)"."Sales order ID"  
	WHERE	 "Sales Orders (Zoho Books)"."Status"  NOT IN ( 'draft'  , 'void'  )
	GROUP BY 1,
		 2,
		 3,
		 4,
		 5,
		  6 /* --- Inner Subquery End --- */ 
 
 
 
) AS  "Inv_Base" 
ORDER BY "Date" ASC

SELECT
		 cp."Payment ID",
		 cp."Payment Number",
		 cp."Payment Date",
		 c."Customer Name",
		 cp."Customer ID",
		 ip."Invoice ID",
		 inv."Invoice Number",
		 inv."Invoice Date",
		 ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date",
		 DATEDIFF(ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date", cp."Payment Date") AS "Days From Payment Date",
		 DATEDIFF(ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date", inv."Invoice Date") AS "Days From Invoice Date",
		 
			CASE
				 WHEN ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  > cp."Payment Date"
				 AND	ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  > inv."Invoice Date" THEN 'Applied After Both Payment and Invoice'
				 WHEN ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  < cp."Payment Date"
				 AND	ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  < inv."Invoice Date" THEN 'Applied Before Both Payment and Invoice'
				 ELSE 'Arbitrary Applied Date'
			 END AS "Mismatch Type",
		 ip."Amount (BCY)" AS "Amount Applied",
		 cp."Payment Mode",
		 cp."Reference Number"
FROM  "Customer Payments (Zoho Books)" cp
JOIN "Invoice Payments (Zoho Books)" ip ON cp."Payment ID"  = ip."Payment ID" 
JOIN "Invoices (Zoho Books)" inv ON ip."Invoice ID"  = inv."Invoice ID" 
JOIN "Customers (Zoho Books)" c ON cp."Customer ID"  = c."Customer ID"  
WHERE	 ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  IS NOT NULL
 AND	ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  != cp."Payment Date"
 AND	ip."Invoice Payment Applied Date"  != inv."Invoice Date"

			 sum(cp."Amount (BCY)") AS 'Amount',
			 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cp."Customer ID"  ORDER BY cp."Payment Date" DESC ) AS 'rn'
	FROM  "Customer Payments (Zoho Books)" cp 
	GROUP BY 1,
		  3 
) last3 ON c."Customer ID"  = last3."Customer Id" 
JOIN(	SELECT
			 inv."Customer ID" AS 'Customer Id',
			 SUM(inv."Balance (BCY)") AS 'Total Outstanding'
	FROM  "Invoices (Zoho Books)" inv 
	WHERE	 inv."Status"  != 'Void'
	 AND	inv."Balance (BCY)"  > 0
	GROUP BY  inv."Customer ID" 
) outstanding ON c."Customer ID"  = outstanding."Customer Id" 
LEFT JOIN(	SELECT
			 q."Customer ID" AS 'Customer Id',
			 round(AVG(q."Payment Days"), 2) AS 'Average Payment Days Last 30 Days',
			 COUNT(DISTINCT q."Payment Id") AS 'Payment Frequency Last 30 Days',
			 SUM(q."Paid Amount") AS 'Paid Amount Last 30 Days'
	FROM  "Payment Days Calculation Query" q 
	WHERE	 q."Payment Date"  >= ADDDATE(CURRENT_DATE(), -30)
	 AND	q."Payment Id"  IS NOT NULL
	GROUP BY  q."Customer ID" 
) stats ON c."Customer ID"  = stats."Customer Id"  
GROUP BY c."Customer ID",
	 c."Customer Name",
	 outstanding."Total Outstanding",
	 stats."Average Payment Days Last 30 Days",
	 stats."Payment Frequency Last 30 Days",
	  stats."Paid Amount Last 30 Days"
